input.change_text: accept logging/setLevel and ping before initialized notification ([#730](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk/pull/730))

output.subject: rmcp accepts logging/setLevel and ping before initialized notification
output.action_text: Upgrade `rmcp` to 1.1.1+ if clients send `logging/setLevel` or `ping` before the `initialized` notification. Pre-fix the server rejected these requests during the early handshake window; the spec permits both at any time, so callers will now succeed instead of erroring.
